projectDescription: A multi-page beach resort website where guests can explore destinations, compare accommodations, preview dining options, read coastal travel guides, and make booking inquiries.
keyFeatures: Three accommodation tiers: First Class Room ($220/night), Deluxe Room ($150/night), and Suite Room ($180/night)
Curated reef dive destinations including Gale Reef (Sri Lanka), Dawson's Reef (Australia), and Claire's Reef (Bermuda)
Resort dining options: Seafood Special, Sumptuous Desserts, and Breakfast Buffet
Comprehensive coastal travel guide covering water safety, kayaking, reef etiquette, and vacation planning tips
Online booking form with room selection, date picker, and guest count
Guest contact form for reservations, experiences, and special service requests
Safety-first content sourced from NPS, NOAA, and U.S. Coast Guard
publicApiSurface: GET booking.html?room=first-class — pre-selects First Class Room in the booking form
GET booking.html?room=deluxe — pre-selects Deluxe Room in the booking form
GET booking.html?room=suite — pre-selects Suite Room in the booking form
POST contact.html — guest inquiry form (name, email, subject, message)
GET contact.html — booking form submission target (room, guests, check-in, check-out, name, email, phone, requests)
